item.title: Why there are no numbers in the forest

item.title: Twelve trees, one year
item.description: A tree can only hold so much before it stops meaning anything. I found this out by building the wrong version first.

item.title: A hard day is not a broken streak

item.title: Your words never leave your phone
item.description: Most apps say "we take your privacy seriously." Here's what Kodama says instead: **we never receive your words, so there is nothing for us to take seriously.**
